about: Holiday macro templates. Wording only: every date, number, price, code and rule comes from policies.json.
{{placeholder}} = filled by your helpdesk when the macro is used. Allowed: customer_first_name, order_number, tracking_url, agent_first_name.
[[fact]] = filled from policies.json when the macro is generated. If a fact on a normal line is missing, the macro is NOT generated and the gap is reported.
A line starting with ? is optional: it is dropped when one of its facts is missing.
'when' generates the macro only if a yes/no fact is true ('!fact' = only if false). 'requires_any' needs at least one of the listed facts.
'use_from' / 'use_until' name date facts (optionally +N or -N days) and set the dates the macro should be used.
'if_missing': 'warning' makes a missing policy for this macro a warning (default: noted only). 'replaces' lists words that identify old macros it replaces, matched on the old macro's name.

The script refuses templates whose name or wording contains digits, month names, $ or %, and wording with promise words (guarantee, refund, free, always, never, Christmas, holiday, arrive by, in full): put those facts in policies.json.
The fact list is in DATA_CONTRACT.md section 5.

templates.name: WISMO: not shipped yet
body: Thanks for checking on order {{order_number}}. [[same_day_rule]]. Once yours has shipped, reply here any time and I'll send you the tracking link.

templates.name: WISMO: BFCM order not shipped yet
body: Thank you for your order {{order_number}}, and for your patience while we work through our Black Friday orders. Orders placed [[backlog_orders]] ship within [[backlog_ship_days]], and we expect to be fully caught up by [[backlog_clears]].
Once your order has shipped, reply here any time and I'll send you the tracking link.

templates.name: WISMO: shipped, in transit
body: Good news: order {{order_number}} is on its way. You can follow it here: {{tracking_url}}
Carriers are busier than usual this time of year, so tracking can take a little longer to update. If it looks stuck, reply to this email and we'll check with the carrier for you.

templates.name: Shipping: holiday order-by dates
body: Here are the last days to order for delivery by [[deliver_by]]:
?These dates hold for most addresses ([[delivery_coverage]] of our customers).
Choose [[checkout_options]] at checkout. If you've already ordered, reply with your order number and I'll check which one you picked.

templates.name: Shipping: only the fastest method is still on time
body: The last order date has passed for [[earlier_services]], but there's still time: choose [[last_service]] at checkout and order by [[last_cutoff]] for delivery by [[deliver_by]].
?That date holds for most addresses ([[delivery_coverage]] of our customers).

templates.name: Shipping: after the last order date
body: I'm sorry, the last day to order for delivery by [[deliver_by]] was [[last_cutoff]]. We're still shipping every order, but we can't promise it will get there in time.

templates.name: Discount: code not working
body: Sorry for the trouble at checkout! [[one_code_rule]] [[sale_stack_rule]]
If your total still doesn't look right, reply with a screenshot of your cart and I'll take a look.

templates.name: Discount: item not in the sale
body: Thanks for reaching out! Items in our [[sale_excludes]] collections aren't part of the [[sale_name]], so the discount doesn't apply to them.

templates.name: Price adjustment: request (we offer them)
body: Thanks for asking! If an item you bought drops in price within [[pa_window]] of your order, we offer a price adjustment.

templates.name: Price adjustment: request (we don't offer them)
body: Thanks for reaching out, and I understand the timing is frustrating. We don't offer price adjustments on past orders.

templates.name: Order: change or cancel
body: We can change or cancel an order within [[edit_window]] of it being placed.
Once that time has passed, we can't change or cancel it.
?Once it arrives, you can return eligible items: start at [[return_start]].

templates.name: Order: change the shipping address
body: We can update the shipping address on order {{order_number}} until [[address_until]]. Reply with the full new address, including any apartment or unit number, and I'll confirm once it's changed.

templates.name: Returns: holiday window
body: Good news: orders placed from [[holiday_from]] to [[holiday_to]] can be returned until [[holiday_return_by]], so there's no rush. Other orders can be returned within [[return_window]].

templates.name: Returns: returning a gift
body: ?Gifts ordered from [[holiday_from]] to [[holiday_to]] can be returned until [[holiday_return_by]].

templates.name: Damaged or defective item
body: I'm so sorry your order arrived damaged.
We'll send you [[damage_resolution]]. Please let us know about any damage within [[damage_days]] of delivery.
?If that's worth more than [[refund_over]], [[escalation_owner]] approves it first, and I'll let you know as soon as they have.

templates.name: Gift options
body: Happy to help with your gift!

templates.name: Out of stock: when is it back?
Holiday support hours
body: Thanks for your message! Our support team is available [[support_regular]], and we reply within [[first_reply]].

templates.name: Shipping: international orders
body: Thanks for asking! We ship to [[ships_to]].
